digest: Coverage centred on Max Verstappen inheriting pole after Kimi Antonelli's grid penalty, despite Verstappen describing a mysterious Red Bull issue that cannot be fixed in Las Vegas. Slipstreaming was a major theme: Mercedes' tow plan for George Russell fell apart (Motorsport.com), and Russell and Antonelli will hold talks over team-orders confusion. Isack Hadjar admitted underestimating the tow (Motorsport.com). Straightline speed also drew attention, with Lando Norris calling McLaren's "shocking" and Charles Leclerc lamenting Ferrari's "crazy" deficiency after both cars fell in Q2 (Motorsport.com).
